supplementaryReferences.title: Cultivar and product choice
supplementaryReferences.quote: Suited to the production of high quality olive oil and as a cross pollinator
supplementaryReferences.note: Frantoio is described as an oil and cross-pollen candidate. Mission suits black table olives and oil; Kalamata black table, Manzanilla and Barouni green table. Climate fit and pollen needs depend on cultivar.

supplementaryReferences.title: Regional orchard budget is not per-tree yield evidence
supplementaryReferences.quote: ENTERPRISE BUDGET SUMMARY ESTABLISHMENT TO FULL BEARING
supplementaryReferences.doc: Western Cape Department of Agriculture, Oil Olives, Garden/Little Karoo budget, 13 March 2021
supplementaryReferences.note: This is a historical one-hectare financial model; it does not provide matched per-tree kg or a measured biological maturity curve. No financial values or pesticide recipes are copied.

care: Match the cultivar to table olives or oil. Check drainage, irrigation and winter conditions; humid summer rainfall can bring disease problems.
Pick at the intended green, black or oil stage. Processing and safe kept-stock conditions must be recorded separately.
purchase: Mission is a source-backed black-table and oil candidate; Kalamata is for black table olives; Manzanilla and Barouni for green table olives; Frantoio for oil and compatible pollen. Confirm regional fit through SA Olive's registered nurseries.
